site.name: Atlantic Mine
site.location: Ward Mining District, Boulder County, Colorado
overview: Atlantic Mine is a documented historic gold-and-silver mine locality in Boulder County's Ward Mining District.
Boulder-area archival collections preserve the Atlantic name in nineteenth-century Ward mining records, while USGS-derived topographic mapping provides a stable mine-level identification point.

timeline.text: Boulder County mining ledgers preserve Atlantic Mine in the Ward Mining District during the district's nineteenth-century mining era.
A surviving Ward mining-district pictorial review in the Carnegie Library for Local History collection includes Atlantic Mine among the mines documented for the district.

moreHistory: The Carnegie Library for Local History county-ledger collection identifies Atlantic Mine in the Ward Mining District, establishing a historic Boulder County identity independent of similarly named Atlantic mines elsewhere in Colorado.

USGS-derived topographic listings place the Boulder County Atlantic Mine at approximately 40.13971, -105.42750 on the Raymond quadrangle and identify it as a gold-and-silver mine. Remnant uses that mapped locality as a site-level identification point, not as a claim that a surviving portal, shaft collar, property boundary, or current access condition has been field-surveyed.

A focused exact-site media search located archival Ward material but did not establish a direct, reusable exact-site image with sufficiently clear package-ready rights and source metadata, so no image is attached.
